summary.en: Hermes Agent integration: lets Hermes author Archi-Made-Easy JSON IR and render through the Archi-Made-Easy CLI — no code loaded into Archi-Made-Easy.
summary.zh: Archi-Made-Easy 的 Hermes Agent 集成。以目录插件形式让 Hermes 编写 Archi-Made-Easy JSON IR 并通过 Archi-Made-Easy CLI 渲染图，不向 Archi-Made-Easy 本体加载任何代码。
